Name: Simple World Map
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]✦ Simple World Map ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#86EFAC]See where to go, what to bring and whose birthday it is.[/color][/b][/center]
[center]Make your normal world map more useful with [b]quest destinations, readiness checks, birthday highlights and donation-box markers[/b]. Open a complete quest log, choose which quests appear and adjust the map from an outside settings cog.[/center]
[center][color=#FDE68A]World map only • Simple Quest Map features included • 75–150% scale • Mouse and controller controls[/color][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🗺 Your world map, with useful context[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53625/53625-1791516248-1506889689.png[/img][/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]World map:[/b] gold quest outlines, green readiness checks and bright purple birthday highlights. Settings sits outside the upper-right border, Quest log at the bottom left and Birthdays at the bottom right.[/center]
[center]Open the [b]normal game map[/b] to use the mod. Select a quest marker for its objective and Journal actions. If several quests share a destination, choose from their list. No separate map key is required.[/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53625/53625-1791516259-1501306238.png[/img]
[center]Uses recorded destinations and loaded map coordinates; unsupported destinations remain in the quest log.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]📖 A quest log that keeps the useful destinations first[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53625/53625-1791516273-487260829.png[/img][/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]Quest log:[/b] keep per-quest Show on map choices, open the original Journal entry and read donation progress. Quests without mapped destinations appear after quests with known destinations.[/center]
[center]Use the bottom-left [b]Quest log[/b] button to see your active quests. Each visibility choice belongs to that specific quest receipt, so accepting another copy does not accidentally reuse the wrong choice. Unsupported destinations remain in the list with a link to their Journal details.[/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Seven filters[/color][/b]
[b]All • Quests • Birthdays • NPCs • Ready • Timed • Pinned[/b]
Choose a filter inside Settings. The former All markers toolbar is removed; the main Show Markers checkbox controls this mod’s overlays.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Ready to finish?[/color][/b]
Delivery quests check the required item stack. Fishing, resource and monster objectives distinguish work still to do from returning to speak. Completed fishing challenges do not require you to keep the caught fish.[/quote][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]📦 Find donation and drop-off containers[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53625/53625-1791516284-66650352.png[/img][/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]Native donation boxes:[/b] a chest marker uses the order’s recorded container location and tile. Supported special orders include nine-slot donation containers.[/center]
[center]For supported native special orders, the quest list shows [b]deposited progress[/b], while marker details show remaining requirements and confirmation readiness. Go to the container and donate through the game’s usual interface. Lost-item quests can also use their exact recorded tiles.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🎂 Birthdays that stand out[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53625/53625-1791516307-1662439163.png[/img][/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]Birthdays:[/b] open the birthday list from the bottom-right control. Purple outlines remain visible beside quest/readiness outlines when the same villager has both.[/center]
[center]Birthday and quest visibility have separate checkboxes. A villager with both keeps both highlights under Quests, Ready, Timed or Pinned filters; birthday-only villagers appear under All or Birthdays. Square and Circle outlines can be chosen independently. Positions follow available map coordinates and respect supported portrait-hiding settings.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]⚙ An outside cog for your map preferences[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53625/53625-1791516323-754603641.png[/img][/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]Top-right Settings cog outside the map:[/b] Show Markers, Show quests, Show birthdays and the 75–150% scale slider are visible together. Choose Save to apply changes or Cancel to keep your previous preferences.[/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53625/53625-1791516353-1871895976.png[/img]
[center]Save applies your choices; Cancel keeps the previous settings. GMCM shares the same saved preferences.
The optional Open world map hotkey starts unassigned.[/center]
[center]The map keeps its scale and corner controls when this mod’s markers are hidden. [b]Show Markers controls Simple World Map’s overlays[/b]; portraits drawn independently by another map mod remain under that mod’s settings.[/center]
[center][color=#67E8F9][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/color] is [b]optional[/b]. It shares the saved map preferences and lets you assign the initially unbound Open world map hotkey.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]🎨 Vanilla parchment and familiar gold controls[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53625/53625-1791516365-1292540298.png[/img][/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]Compact quest list:[/b] vanilla parchment, native lettering, gold embedded controls and native scrolling artwork. The map and outside cog fit the available screen; input follows the displayed scale.[/center]
[center]Settings and quest rows use [b]loaded vanilla parchment and native text colours[/b]. Buttons, checkboxes, the scale slider, scrollbars and arrows use loaded Stardew artwork, alongside the existing cog and navigation icons. The settings cog sits outside the upper-right map border, with room reserved on smaller screens and no overlap with the close button.[/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Mouse[/color][/b]
Select a marker for details. Use the cog, quest log and birthday list; scroll or drag the gold scrollbar.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Scale slider[/color][/b]
Drag the slider or use minus/plus. Left/Right adjusts the focused scale row.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Controller on map[/color][/b]
LB/RB selects markers and corner actions. D-pad moves focus; A activates.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Controller in panels[/color][/b]
D-pad moves focus, LB/RB pages, A selects and B returns or cancels. X saves Settings.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Quest list[/color][/b]
A opens the original Journal entry. X toggles Show on map for the selected quest.[/quote][/center]
[center]Multiple quests on one marker open a list. Returning from Journal details restores the previous map/list.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🧩 Compatibility and languages[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53625/53625-1791516410-1562771372.png[/img][/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]Ridgeside integration:[/b] overlays and scaled controls support the expansion’s separate map and hosted child map while preserving the original return path.[/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Requirements[/color][/b]
[b]Desktop Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and [color=#67E8F9][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.4.0 or later[/url][/color].
No other Simple mod is required. Android support has not been established for this release.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]NPC Map Locations[/color][/b]
[color=#67E8F9][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url][/color] is optional. Simple World Map can use its portraits and supported visibility flags. It does not invent a missing position or override hidden portraits.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Ridgeside Village[/color][/b]
[color=#67E8F9][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url][/color] is optional. Its map integration is included; this is not a promise that every scripted expansion quest has a mapped destination.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Simple Journal Pin[/color][/b]
The Pinned filter reads existing [color=#67E8F9][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52801]Simple Journal Pin[/url][/color] pins without changing them. The pin mod is optional.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Custom quests and maps[/color][/b]
Standard supported quest data and loaded map coordinates are used when available. Scripted destinations need explicit metadata or a resolver integration. Unmapped quests remain accessible in the log; destinations are not guessed from dialogue.[/quote][/center]
[center][b]Languages:[/b] English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish and Hungarian. Existing quest translations and the main new controls are included; five newer help/empty-state strings fall back to English outside English.[/center]
[center]This release was checked with [b]439 source/configuration and isolated native quest/input/rendering checks[/b], including twelve-language previews, native donation definitions and Ridgeside map fixtures. Full live modpack, multiplayer and physical-controller testing remain pending. The interface images here are isolated native-renderer previews with illustrative quests.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]📥 Installation and updating[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]1. Install [color=#67E8F9][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/color].
2. Extract the download and place the [b]SimpleWorldMap[/b] folder inside [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
3. Launch through SMAPI and open the normal map.[/center]
[center]Install the [b]extracted folder[/b], not the ZIP. When updating, replace the mod files and retain config.json to keep your preferences. Restart the game after replacing files. No save reset is required.[/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Replacing standalone Simple Quest Map?[/color][/b]
[b]Simple Quest Map’s features are included in this download.[/b] Remove the standalone SimpleQuestMap folder and keep SimpleWorldMap. Existing per-farmer quest visibility uses the original save keys, but standalone SQM’s separate config is not imported; choose your preferences in SWM.[/quote][/center]
[center]If both mods are accidentally present, SWM yields the map overlays to standalone SQM to avoid duplicate controls. To use the interface shown here, keep SimpleWorldMap only.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]💬 Before you download[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Does this add an area view or minimap?[/color][/b]
This release works on the world map. Area view and scenery capture have been removed. It does not add a minimap.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Does it change quests or inventory?[/color][/b]
Quest progress, item transfers and NPC schedules continue to work through the game. This mod saves display preferences and quest-visibility metadata. Donation-box markers guide you to the container; deposits use the native donation menu.[/quote][/center]
[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Need help with a missing marker?[/color][/b]
Include your SMAPI log, game/mod versions, game/UI scale, quest title, destination and any quest or map mods involved. Unsupported destinations still appear in the quest log so you can open their Journal details.[/quote][/center]
[center][b]Credits:[/b] Stardew Valley and its native artwork/fonts belong to ConcernedApe. Optional integrations use information supplied by their respective mods; those mods are separate downloads.[/center]
